authority.briefScopeVerbatim:
YOU BUILD ONLY GAMEPLAY SYSTEMS (no map geometry, no hero models):
1. Trooper system: squads of 4 per team per lane every 25s, march lane waypoints,
   fight nearest enemy (troopers > heroes > structures), candle-head burn-down at
   low HP (emissive scale), respawn wave logic, lane push.
2. Souls economy: floating orb (projectile-take: shooting splits 50/50 secure/deny),
   ground orb (claim radius 5m, magnet walk, 18s lifetime), soul counter UI,
   souls = levels (auto level: +stats per level tier) AND currency for shop.
   Comeback math: losing-team multiplier up to +26%.
3. Item shop: 4 tiers (800/1600/3200/6400), shop opens on death + at base +
   hotkey (B). Items: tier1 (ammo/health/sprint), tier2 (lifesteal/slow rounds/
   dash charge), tier3 (burst fire/heavy melee charge/shadow cloak), tier4
   (armor pierce/glass cannon). Max 9 slots, 3 flex unlocks via Walker kills.
4. Hero death/respawn: death timer scaled by game minute, respawn base; healing
   retreat zone at own base. Retreat-to-base teleport (hold X at base ring).
5. Match flow director: pregame 30s, laning (waves spawn), mid-game 10-min juncture
   (trooper bounty up), win/loss detection wiring to structures/HP.
6. IN AN AGREED INTERFACE: read world spawn/waypoint data from
   docs/jank3d-spawns.json (world team exports; if not yet exported, create
   procedural fallback lanes so your sim runs independent).

ACCEPTANCE FOR YOU: B (wave logic), C (orbs), D (10-min scripted headless sim
drives: waves push -> structures fall in chain order -> Patron P1 -> P2 -> win),
F (shop). Run the sim in Node with a stubbed renderer or headless chromium.
Log a timeline file proving order of objective falls.
Report files + screenshots (of any visual bits like orb FX and shop UI) + blockers.
No self-grading - reviewer grades.
